about_the_game: Set sail into the depths of eternity with the Cosmic Wanderer pack! This pack unlocks the Empire of the Cosmos trait that rewards Godir who aspire mastery of all the affinities, as well as the attire and weaponry you will need for your journey into the hidden reaches of the Astral Sea!
